title: Finnish Civil War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Finnish Civil War", at revision 1375858302, opens: "The Finnish Civil War was fought in 1918 for the leadership and control of recently independent Finland between White Finland and the Finnish Socialist Workers' Republic. The clashes took place in the context of the national, political, and social turmoil caused by World War I in Europe. The belligerents were the paramilitary Red Guards, led by a section of the Social Democratic Party with backup of the Russian bolsheviks, and the paramilitary White Guards of the senate." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q211855, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1918 civil war in Finland". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
